items.question: According to the Baker Financial Journal, investors' ---- for technology stocks rose sharply this quarter.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：所有格 investors' 后需名词作主语。 选择理由：enthusiasm是名词，A正确。正确答案：A（enthusiasm）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段第 1 句：According to the Baker Financial Journal, investors' ---- for technology stocks rose sharply this quarter.
choice_translations: B：热衷者；爱好者（名词，指人）
